Class LanguageManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.client.LanguageManager
public class LanguageManager extends Object
Manages application language settings and localization. Supports switching between locales and accessing localized messages.

    • setPendingLocale

      public static void setPendingLocale(Locale locale)
      Sets the pending locale to be applied on the next update. Does not immediately reload resources.
      Parameters:
      locale - the new locale to be used

    • cycleLanguages

      public static void cycleLanguages()
      Cycles between supported locales (English and Italian). Updates the pending locale but does not apply it immediately.

    • applyPendingLocale

      public static void applyPendingLocale()
      Applies the pending locale, if it differs from the current one. This reloads the resource bundle to reflect the new language.
